newsitem.title: UK: Ward ends talks about selling company.
newsitem.headline: Ward ends talks about selling company.

text.p: British house builder Ward Holdings Plc said on Tuesday it has ended talks with parties who have been looking to buy the company and now plans to pay a special dividend.

"The board considers that the discussions currently being held with potential offerors for Ward are unlikely to lead to an adequate realisation of the value inherent in the company," said Ward Holdings in a statement.
Ward said in June that members of the Ward family representing over 51 percent of the company's share capital were looking to sell their shares.
The Ward family has controlled the company since it was floated in 1972.
Ward now plans to pay a special dividend of 1p per share after it decided not to pay an interim dividend with its half year results on July 3.
